hannah: Heads-up — onboarding smoke test failed for the JS SDK after the recent export map change. Local worker dev crashes with `Unexpected token export` and TypeScript is resolving to the CJS d.ts, so editors show wrong types. Also noticed two token requests on startup.
diego: can you paste the exports block + the import used by the sample?
hannah: sure, exports section is: ```json
\"exports\": {
  \".\": {
    \"import\": \"./dist/esm/index.mjs\",
    \"require\": \"./dist/cjs/index.cjs\"
  },
  \"./package.json\": \"./package.json\"
}
```
hannah: sample imports like `import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood-js-sdk'` (vanilla quickstart).
li: this smells like two problems: 1) some dev bundler (wrangler/vite) resolves the export condition but later wraps modules for HMR, producing a mixed bundle where ESM syntax ends up inside a CJS wrapper -> runtime parse error, 2) two runtime instances (esm + cjs) or HMR re-eval causing duplicate init -> duplicate token requests.
diego: i can repro with a minimal vite+wrangler setup. explicit import `import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood-js-sdk/dist/esm/edge.mjs'` fixes the parse error and the double token fetch disappears. not ideal as permanent fix.
hannah: TypeScript oddness: my editor points to `dist/cjs/index.d.ts` even though runtime is ESM. I think we didn't add a conditional types mapping, so TS falls back to main types which point at cjs.
orchid: suggested mitigation list: - add a small `dist/esm/edge.mjs` entry file and document it in the edge sample; - make SDK init idempotent (module-scoped guard + await in-flight init Promise) so duplicate loads don't trigger side-effects; - add CI smoke test for edge quickstart with wrangler+vite; - investigate conditional typings or add a `types` field that points to `dist/esm/index.d.ts`.
li: i agree. avoid nonstandard export conditions (like an "edge" condition) in package.json because tooling is inconsistent. publishing an explicit edge entry and recommending explicit imports in samples is safer.
diego: i'll prototype an init guard today: var __rdw_init; export async function init(){ if(__rdw_init) return __rdw_init; __rdw_init = (async ()=>{ /* real init */ })(); return __rdw_init; } — should prevent concurrent token calls.
hannah: i'll update the quickstart README to include the explicit import workaround and a short troubleshooting note about bundler HMR + .mjs semantics.
orchid: filing an issue to track: @dev-bot can you create RDW ticket and add labels devex, sdk-exports, types, edge?
dev-bot: Created RDW-5600 — "Export map change triggers mixed ESM/CJS bundles, types mismatch, and duplicate auth init in edge quickstart" (labels: devex, sdk-exports, types, edge)
diego: next steps: 1) guard PR for idempotent init (me) 2) README update for explicit edge import (hannah) 3) add CI smoke job (orchid) 4) follow-up on conditional types research (li).
hannah: thanks — will also add a short repro gist in the issue so infra can run it quickly.
li: once guard looks good we can cut a 2.4.1 patch that mitigates the worst customer pain without reverting the exports. if customers keep hitting it we can consider rolling back.
orchid: noted. tracking in RDW-5600 and linking sample PRs/patches. :+1:
